title: velo landing page
brief: Landing page for velo, a single-binary terminal music player, to publish on GitHub Pages; modelled on cliamp.stream, whose install section is a one-liner per platform with copy buttons. Content comes from velo's README: install commands and release targets, gapless/ReplayGain/bit-perfect/mono, the four library views, radio (Radio Browser plus the cliamp channels), themes as TOML files, and the one-binary-no-daemon-no-telemetry promise.

artboards.title: Terminal first
artboards.tradeoff: Shows the product itself above the fold, in velo's own factory palette, so the pitch is verifiable at a glance; the install block sits below it, and a six-card grid carries the feature detail.

artboards.title: Manual, single column
artboards.tradeoff: Reads like the documentation a person would trust to install software: one 44rem measure, numbered chapters, install as a stepped list. Weakest emotional pull, strongest legibility and the easiest to keep in sync with the README.

artboards.title: Split hero, live panel
artboards.tradeoff: Product-forward: the promise and a platform-aware install one-liner on the left, a playing panel with a moving spectrum on the right, so the page feels like the app. Less room for feature detail above the fold; the spectrum is decorative and stops under prefers-reduced-motion.
